passages.text: The completion atlas keeps eleven lifecycle stages separate on seven candidate architectures. None of the branches is a completed Lorentzian quantum theory. The strict 386-row branch now has an exact graph-coordinate unary differential, a common-bound local endpoint SDR, transported suspension, represented advanced/retarded Green names, the local cylinder-flow action, linked common source q2/q3 snapshots, and a complete local cyclic pairing. The M3L manifest pins 10 artifacts and 17 canonical object hashes; all 15 compatibility links agree and every projected defect is zero. M4L has exact pairing rank 386 on 386 local rows with 410 ordered entries, and all declared q1/SDR/D/q2/q3 local cyclicity defects vanish. M3R compares 4,080 represented endpoint-complex coefficients with 470 W+/W- residual coordinates at energies two through six; its E/A/L magnetic crosswalk, retraction, and q0 chain identities have zero defects. Direct pullback to that one-sided degree-zero target is obstructed: the induced degree-minus-one odd form has exact rank 0 and nullity 470. M3RC-A repairs the carrier formally: the unchanged 4,490-coordinate source has H0=470 and H1=0, so it cannot retract onto the doubled residual carrier; the declared 8,980-coordinate shifted cotangent complex instead retracts exactly onto 940 coordinates with full/residual pairing ranks 8,980/940 and zero declared defects. M3RC-B gives all 470 formal residual duals explicit compact-source causal representatives and identifies the action/Green and canonical cotangent pairings at exact rank 940. M4R then replays five shifted-cotangent blocks and verifies q-res cyclicity, projection-adjointness, homotopy skewness, inclusion isometry, contraction and normalized side conditions with 0 defects. These are finite represented theorems, not an all-energy completion or an identification of the formal comparison source with the authoritative full BV source. M1A is now complete. M1A2 typed all 386 local rows and its 2,560-component Cotton replay has 0 defects. M1A3 types 4,080 represented endpoint rows, excludes 410 comparison-only test rows arranged in 205 doublets, and types 470 primal plus 470 action-dual residual rows with zero partition, degree and crosswalk defects. M1A4 freezes 17,779 authoritative rows across 6 distinct content-addressed objects, with 0 untyped rows and 0 category-identification defects. The formal 8,980-row cotangent fixture remains non-authoritative. M1B and M1C now close on one immutable snapshot and Gate A is verified. The q2/q3 Green compatibility and Hadamard layers remain fail closed.
